title: Jejob's Enhanced MC
description:
a modpack that only updates the games visuals.

"a big modpack for tiny people"
body:
This modpack is for people who want to play a "enhanced version" of Minecraft. What I mean by this is all this modpack does is enhance the visuals of Minecraft, making the game more "modern", so to speak.

**Though this there are server side mods, this adds NOTHING NEW, it only changes the VISUALS, including but not limited to, animations, graphics, textures, etc.**


There are around 75+ mods in this modpack, including but not limited to:

Punchy! - https://modrinth.com/mod/punchy-fpa

Iris - https://modrinth.com/mod/iris

Explosive Enhancement - https://modrinth.com/mod/explosive-enhancement

Camera Overhaul - https://modrinth.com/mod/cameraoverhaul

and much more!

This modpack also includes many different shaders via Iris, as well as resource packs powered by Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features.
